description: Bus Routes Metro (PTV) is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Curated and Published by City of Casey, sourced from Public Transport Victoria. This dataset provides information on Metro Bus routes that describes the route, destination stop, timetable link, and service provider in the City of Casey. Sourced from the Public Transport Victoria. Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Community, Transport. Its keywords are Community, Transport, Bus Stop, Public, Bus, Infrastructure. The portal shows 186 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
